title: Enterprise Questionnaire Response Marketplace for Solution Engineers — bundling, credits, and SLA routing
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a self-serve marketplace in the Console for Sales and Solution Engineers to obtain pre-packaged enterprise questionnaire responses and attestation bundles. Each bundle is a curated, reviewable set of answers (SIG/CAIQ and similar) plus verifiable evidence attachments and an audit trail. The marketplace supports per-bundle credits, usage-based discounts, SLA routing for high-priority customers, and an approval path for Legal/Compliance reviews.
background: Large enterprise deals stall because SEs must assemble bespoke security questionnaire responses or wait on Legal/Compliance to prepare evidence packs. Existing attestation efforts are ad-hoc, create duplicated work, and are hard to charge back to deals. Previous initiatives (e.g., modularized evidence, signed wallets) reduced effort but didn't provide a discoverable, billable surface for GTM to consume. This ticket pilots a marketplace that makes response bundles discoverable, purchasable, and trackable with minimal Legal overhead.
goals_metrics: Primary: Reduce mean time-to-first-response for questionnaires from inbound sales by 60% for pilot accounts
Secondary: Increase SE self-serve bundle adoption to 40% of eligible deals within 8 weeks
Economic: Measure credit consumption per deal and target net revenue uplift of 3-5% on pilot accounts through improved win rates
Quality: Maintain <= 2% post-delivery revision rate from Legal/Compliance on purchased bundles
experiment_design: We will ship a lightweight 'Marketplace' tab in Console (beta) with three curated bundle tiers: Lite (pre-populated short answers + links), Standard (complete SIG/CAIQ answers + attachments), and Enterprise Complete (signed evidence wallet + prioritized Legal review). Bundles are priced in 'assurance credits' (virtual currency) with an introductory discount for pilot customers. Two experiment arms: A) Enable self-serve purchase + automatic bundle delivery; B) Same as A but with mandatory Legal sign-off for Enterprise Complete (adds SLA routing). Instrumentation: bundle_viewed, bundle_purchased, bundle_applied_to_questionnaire, legal_review_requested, legal_review_completed, evidence_downloaded. Success is measured by conversion funnel and downstream deal velocity. Fallback: if bundle mismatch confidence < threshold, route to 'assisted' queue for SE + Legal triage.
acceptance_criteria: Marketplace UI with list and detail pages for bundles in Console (beta accounts only)
Backend APIs to list bundles, purchase with credits, attach bundle to a customer questionnaire record, and record audit events
Billing flow that decrements credits and shows credit usage in the deal timeline
SLA routing configured for 'Enterprise Complete' to notify Legal/Compliance queues and set TTR targets
Instrumentation events available in analytics dashboards for funnel analysis
Pilot cohort of at least 10 GTM teams and 30 incoming questionnaires enrolled
risks_mitigation: Risk: Incorrect or stale answers cause compliance issues — Mitigation: add review checkbox and audit stamp tied to bundle version and last-reviewed date
Risk: SEs over-consume credits due to confusion — Mitigation: explicit pricing labels, estimated credit cost per bundle, and pre-purchase confirmation modal
Risk: Legal backlog from sudden demand — Mitigation: limit Enterprise Complete purchases via rate-limited SKU and require justification field for high-priority routing
Risk: Customer expects customization — Mitigation: include 'micro-bundles' for specific sections and clear messaging that bundles are starting points, with an assisted option
